provenance.method: Loaded and answered Embed inputs at int4: one ordinary Load, then two Embed inputs requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API. Mac in use (other jobs and downloads running). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.

peakMemoryGB.basis: Load and two Embed inputs requests on three short sentences.

provenance.method: Sum of macOS phys_footprint_peak over all Arsenal worker processes (only the measured model was loaded) across one ordinary Load, then two Embed inputs requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API; MiB converted to GB (10^9 bytes). Mac in use (other jobs and downloads running). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.

secondsPerRequest.basis: One warm Embed inputs request on three short sentences.

provenance.method: Wall time of the timed (second) Embed inputs request, one sample, after one ordinary Load, then two Embed inputs requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API; includes the API round trip. Mac in use (other jobs and downloads running). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.
